create_nuscenes_info: create nuscenes dataset info pickle files for train and val splits with configurable max sweeps
create_groundtruth_database: create a ground truth database of 3D bounding box point clouds from nuscenes lidar sweeps
balanced_infos_resampling: perform class-balanced resampling of nuscenes dataset samples to equalize class distribution
get_lidar_with_sweeps: retrieve lidar point clouds with optional historical sweeps and time lag appended as a feature
generate_prediction_dicts: generate prediction dictionaries from model output tensors for nuscenes detection evaluation
